name: Vegan Lemon-Jalapeño Lentil Pâté with Cucumber Slices
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Drain and rinse lentils in a colander. Using the back of a spoon, gently press on the lentils to remove excess liquid, then transfer to a medium bowl. Use a fork or potato masher to crush the lentils until they are broken down.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the lentils.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Add oil, Dijon, and spices to the bowl. Stir to combine the lentil pâté.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds.
To serve, divide lentil pâté and cucumber slices between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
